# Gateway conformance report

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @gulley/gateway conformance:report` from the contract suite; do not edit by hand. CI fails when this file drifts (ci/conformance.sh). -->

Gulley executes the rules of [Anthropic's Claude Code gateway compatibility guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol) and [OpenAI's Codex gateway compatibility checklist](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/gateway-compatibility) as black-box tests against the assembled gateway with mock upstreams, on every CI run. This report is regenerated per release.

**Result: 16 of 16 rules pass.**

## Anthropic — Claude Code gateway compatibility guide

| Rule | Requirement | Reference | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `A01-beta-open-list` | Forward the anthropic-beta header verbatim as an open list (never an allowlist), and anthropic-version unchanged | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#request-headers | ✅ pass |
| `A02-no-buffering` | Relay a streamed response event by event: the client receives bytes before the upstream finishes | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#streaming | ✅ pass |
| `A03-ping-relay` | Relay upstream ping events (and comment lines) — never strip or buffer them | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#streaming | ✅ pass |
| `A04-event-order` | Deliver the full event sequence in order through the final message_delta and message_stop | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#streaming | ✅ pass |
| `A05-bedrock-ping-synthesis` | A gateway that translates from an upstream without pings (Bedrock) emits its own ping events during a pause | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#streaming | ✅ pass |
| `A06-error-body-verbatim` | Forward error response bodies unmodified, with retry-after as integer seconds, x-should-retry and anthropic-ratelimit-unified-* unchanged | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#response-headers | ✅ pass |
| `A07-gateway-errors` | Gateway-generated errors use Anthropic's envelope and types and carry x-should-retry | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#response-headers | ✅ pass |
| `A08-model-discovery` | Serve GET /v1/models?limit=1000 directly (no redirect) within 3 seconds, with ids Claude Code keeps (contain "claude") | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#model-discovery | ✅ pass |
| `A09-count-tokens` | Expose POST /v1/messages/count_tokens for exact token counts | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#api-formats | ✅ pass |
| `A10-system-and-body-unchanged` | Forward the system array exactly as received (attribution block first) and body fields such as cache_control, thinking and context_management unchanged — inspect without modifying | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#system-prompt-attribution-block | ✅ pass |
| `A11-capability-rejected-token` | A translated route's error envelope carries a stable capability_rejected: token (prompt_too_long) where the upstream's wording differs | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#automatic-retry-and-error-forwarding | ✅ pass |
| `A12-attribution-headers-consumed` | x-claude-code-* headers may be consumed for attribution and still reach the upstream | code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol#request-headers | ✅ pass |

## OpenAI — Codex gateway compatibility

| Rule | Requirement | Reference | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `C01-responses-sse-incremental` | Accept POST /v1/responses and forward server-sent events incrementally, preserving event types including the terminal response.completed | learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/gateway-compatibility | ✅ pass |
| `C02-function-call-pairing` | Preserve function-call items and their matching function_call_output items, including the identifiers that link them | learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/gateway-compatibility | ✅ pass |
| `C03-error-classes` | Distinguish client authentication errors, unknown model routes, rate limits and upstream failures — never a generic 500 | learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/gateway-compatibility | ✅ pass |
| `C04-model-routing` | Each Codex-facing model name routes to the intended upstream model, verifiable in gateway records | learn.chatgpt.com/docs/enterprise/gateway-compatibility | ✅ pass |

## What is not covered

- Rules that need a real provider (token-count exactness, `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-*` values, model-specific capability rejections) are exercised by the manual live checks (`pnpm --filter @gulley/gateway live:*`), not here.
- The Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel and Google Agent Platform *client* formats are not served: Gulley exposes the Anthropic Messages format and bridges to Bedrock itself.
- `/v1/messages/batches` and `/v1/files` are not proxied.
